channel.title: Crypto Docket
channel.description: Crypto Docket reports news across crypto: Bitcoin and Ethereum, layer-2 networks, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: Binance confirms $6.3B hot-wallet loss, pledges full cover
item.description: Binance says hot wallets lost about $6.3 billion in tokens, promises to cover the loss and keeps withdrawals paused during security checks and recovery.

item.title: ICE plans U.S. Hyperliquid perpetuals market with Trade[XYZ]
item.description: ICE and Trade[XYZ] plan a separate U.S. venue for Hyperliquid-based perpetuals, adding 24/7 retail exposure across assets if regulators approve the market.

item.title: Binance freezes $2.54 billion as security probe halts transfers
item.description: Binance is investigating a potential security issue after crypto firms froze $2.54 billion, while deposits and withdrawals were paused and no theft was confirmed.

item.title: DTCC takes tokenized U.S. securities live on two blockchains
item.description: DTCC has launched tokenized versions of eligible securities on Canton and private Besu, linking blockchain transfers to DTC custody and existing investor protections.

item.title: Solana’s Alpenglow is live, but 150ms remains a target
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT; Anza targets 150ms finality, while early public measurements put the median near 404ms.

item.title: Ripple says OCC clears national trust bank after 10 months
item.description: Ripple says its trust bank has final OCC approval to manage RLUSD reserves and offer custody, while issuance stays with its New York regulated affiliate.

item.title: OCC Leaves Stablecoin Rewards Open to Crypto Exchanges
item.description: U.S. regulators dropped a proposed presumption against stablecoin reward deals, leaving exchanges room to pay customers while issuers remain barred from paying yield directly.

item.title: Dogecoin Labs joins MyDoge, DogeOS and Such App under one roof
item.description: Dogecoin Labs will combine MyDoge, DogeOS and Such App, linking a wallet, a developer testnet and merchant tools while leaving adoption and integration unproven.

item.title: South Korea considers fourth crypto tax delay to 2029
item.description: Seoul is weighing a fourth delay to its 22% crypto gains tax, now due in 2027, as a proposed 2029 start ties enforcement to access to US transaction data.

item.title: Rango Bridge gives integrators a cross-chain routing layer
item.description: Rango Bridge can spare apps from building separate routes across chains, while leaving quote quality, wallet signing and transaction recovery to integrate carefully.

item.title: HSBC brings HKD stablecoin payments to PayMe users
item.description: HSBC has launched its HKD stablecoin on PayMe, opening in-app transfers and merchant payments to millions as Hong Kong’s licensed market takes shape.

item.title: HSBC brings RedCoin to PayMe’s 3.3 million users
item.description: HSBC has launched RedCoin through PayMe for transfers and merchant payments, bringing a bank-issued HKD token to retail users ahead of planned investment uses.

item.title: When a Solana Limit Price Crosses the Market
item.description: A crossing limit order can trade immediately at available prices within its bound; on Solana, the result depends on liquidity, order design, fees and execution rules.

item.title: Solana switches to Alpenglow, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on mainnet, replacing TowerBFT with a voting system targeting 150ms finality while leaving wallets, fees and apps unchanged.

item.title: Recurring Crypto Buys Trade Timing Risk for Repetition
item.description: Recurring crypto buys spread a budget across scheduled purchases, smoothing entry timing while adding fees and leaving investors exposed to long declines.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards open to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule leaves exchange stablecoin rewards under case-by-case review, preserving a yield channel while barring issuers from paying direct interest.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with a consensus system targeting 150ms finality while leaving wallets, fees and transaction execution unchanged.

item.title: Mantle Bridge gas: what to hold on each chain
item.description: Mantle uses MNT for gas while Ethereum uses ETH, so bridging an asset does not always leave you ready to transact; budget for both chains and the withdrawal claim.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards open to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC finalized its GENIUS Act rule without barring exchange rewards, but left programs to case-by-case review while issuers remain barred from paying yield.

item.title: Approval clears the allowance, not the swap
item.description: An approval grants a contract permission to spend tokens; it does not reserve a quote, guarantee liquidity or ensure the later swap will meet its execution limits.
